news.description: KBL has rescinded Laguna's (37) registration hold. Lagan A is officially registered as a foreign player belonging to Daegu Korea Gas Corporation in the 2026-2027 season. A KBL official said on the 10th that "following the court ruling, we have decided to proceed with the registration of Lagonia's players as normal." Laguna will enter the country on the 11th and will be ready for the 2026-2027 season after completing the player registration process.
